subject: HEAVY RELEASE lowering-opus: gates aborted after iOS syntax x5 rc=0 (fixing a discard/batch correctness issue first); CLAIM compositor_submit.inc tegu_jm_sidecar_same (my MRT batching fn from C6m)
body: Finding: a batched MRT frame takes draw 0's per-target DISCARD flag; a member from a later pass that STORES rt k while draw 0 discards rt k would lose its writes. Also pass-MRT +1 'mrt' break per pass boundary = member rt1 load_action 0 (DontCare+discard) rejected. Fix: members may carry load 0 only on discard targets; a member that stores rt k cannot join a frame discarding rt k (bridge batch_targets_compatible + compositor tegu_jm_sidecar_same in lockstep).
